manoeuvres.text: leave the parking lot and at the roundabout take the 1st exit
turn right onto Tbilisi — Red Bridge
turn left onto Iakob Tsurtaveli Street
turn right onto Zviad Gamsakhurdia Alley
at the interchange take the ramp on the right and make a U-turn back onto Zviad Gamsakhurdia Alley
turn right onto Kakhaber Tavgorashvili Street
turn left onto Kote Marjanishvili Street
turn left onto David Kldiashvili Street
continue straight onto Zakaria Paliashvili Street
keep right onto Tbilisi — Red Bridge
at the interchange take the ramp on the right and make a U-turn back onto Tbilisi — Red Bridge
at the roundabout take the 2nd exit
arrive at the Service Agency parking and stop
